description: Use this when the user or the project names a Set, such as "Core Line". Not for describing a style (`search_sets`). Next: `search_assets` with the returned `slug` as `setSlug`. Case-insensitive substring match on stored Set names (minimum 3 characters). Use for exact or partial name lookup when the user types a name string. For semantic / intent-based discovery, use `search_sets` instead — these do different things and must not be confused.

name.description: Search string to match against Set names (case-insensitive). Must be at least 3 characters.
